title: Hány óra van? – Telling the time

sections.title: Whole hours
sections.content: To say a whole hour, put the number in front of óra: öt óra (van) is 'it's five o'clock'. To ask for the time, use hány óra van? ('how many hour is it?').
óra does double duty: it means both 'hour' and 'clock'. Hungarian doesn't need two separate words — context always makes clear which one is meant.
